text:
lisa_support: FYI escalation from AcmePay (acct 8421). After today's rollout of atlas-13b-q4 to default, they see more made-up facts in summaries used in customer emails. Example attached below.

emma_cs: this is high priority for them, their trust team flagged multiple customer complaints. they want rollback if we can reproduce quickly.

omar_ml: can we get the exact request + headers? lisa, paste the obfuscated request and the two responses (pre/post). also which shard/region did the canary go to?

lisa_support: deployment note from deploy-bot: rollout started 2026-03-12T02:15Z canary->prod. their repro curl (redacted):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -d '{"model":"atlas-13b-q4","input":"Summarize this dispute: customer claims chargeback due to unrecognized transaction. Provide likely reasons and next steps.","temperature":0.0,"max_tokens":160}'
```

lisa_support: pre-rollout response from their logs (they pasted):
> "Likely causes: cardholder dispute due to unauthorized purchase, billing descriptor confusion, or delayed subscription charge. Next steps: verify transaction ID, contact issuing bank, request supporting docs. For AcmePay support contact, see your org settings."

lisa_support: post-rollout (the one causing issue) they logged: \"Likely causes: unauthorized purchase, billing descriptor confusion, or service trial expiration. Next steps: verify transaction ID, contact issuing bank, request supporting docs. Note: AcmePay was founded in 1994 and compliance@acmepay.com is the correct email to escalate.\"

matthew_research: wow that's definitely a fabricated datum (founding year/email). we need to know if the model's factuality changed globally or only for certain prompt patterns. can you confirm temperature=0.0?

lisa_support: yes they forced temp 0.0. they said calls are routed to prod-us-2 cluster.

omar_ml: can we reproduce locally against previous pinned model (atlas-13b-q4@rev-20260220) vs new (atlas-13b-q4@rev-20260312)? if so capture log-prob or token-level scores around the invented tokens. also check if any quality-safety filters or post-processing changed in the deploy.

sanjay_sre: infra note: there was a kernel update on prod-us-2 at 2026-03-12T01:50Z (cuda-driver 535.x) that rolled alongside the canary. devops_bot: flag attached.

omar_ml: good catch. hardware/kernel changes sometimes affect numeric stability and sampling behavior at extreme low temps. but at temp 0.0 we expect argmax; hallucination still possible due to model weights. need to run A/B.

lisa_support: AcmePay also reported other examples: created a fake support policy number and misattributed a refund amount. they supplied 6 examples; uploading to the shared repro bucket now (link posted in channel).

emma_cs: they want communication template: we told them we're investigating and will provide ETA for rollback. can product/legal review before we promise rollback?

matthew_research: immediate next steps I propose: 1) reproducer run: call both revisions with identical request and record full token stream + logits; 2) run exact same prompt across multiple seeds/hardware (prod-us-1, prod-us-2) to see if regression is deterministic; 3) check evaluation suites for this class of financial prompts for any recent perf delta; 4) surface whether any inference pre/post-processing rules changed in pipeline. assigning to omar and sanjay.

omar_ml: I'll start reproducer now. will attach logs here. if we see the new revision hallucinating and old one not, escalate to model-onboarding for emergency rollback.

sanjay_sre: I'll correlate deploy timeline with kernel/driver/onnxruntime updates and open infra incident if necessary.

(devops_bot): Created incident INC-2026-2935 for \"atlas-13b-q4 factuality regression - AcmePay\". Priority: P1.

lisa_support: AcmePay is pausing auto-emails until we confirm. they're very sensitive because these summaries are customer-facing.

omar_ml: quick note: we should not expose internal evals to the customer. keep repros internal. i'll try to get token-level evidence in ~45m.

matthew_research: also run the prompt through our reranking/citation pipeline (if any) to see if any deterministic post-processor added a string that looks like \"AcmePay was founded in XXXX\". sometimes template merging can introduce org metadata incorrectly.

lisa_support: thanks. keeping channel updated. will add the six customer examples to the incident ticket.

emma_cs: suggest offering them a temporary model pin to previous revision until fixed. legal approved a standard mitigation msg.

(devops_bot): update: prod-us-2 kernel rollback scheduled to 2026-03-12T04:00Z if A/B confirms.

omar_ml: initial reproducer: calling atlas-13b-q4@rev-20260312 yields invented email token at position 48 with high logit; calling atlas-13b-q4@rev-20260220 yields no such token and higher confidence on generic tokens. attaching logs.

matthew_research: ok that lines up. omar, open a model regression ticket with reproducible artifacts and ping model-onboarding. include seed, hardware, driver version.

sanjay_sre: infra will pause further kernel rollouts to prod-us-2 until we finish RCA.

emma_cs: I've drafted a comms note for AcmePay: we will offer pinning to older model and share an incident summary within 72 hours. waiting approval.

lisa_support: AcmePay accepted temporary pin. moving to follow-up. will close thread when incident INC-2026-2935 is resolved."
